sceneHint: WORKING PRINCIPLES · OPEN QUESTIONS · NEXT TESTS

notes.label: develop the software around the signal
notes.copy: The hardware prototype now produces a four-band session summary. The next phase is to improve the data processing, develop the software, and design the UI.
notes.detail: Turn a working measurement into a usable system.

notes.label: check potential confounders
notes.copy: The main study asks whether principle agreement influences perceived relevance between cases. Before interpreting that relationship, the analysis tested whether principle frequency could also affect agreement. No relationship was detected for the principles examined.
notes.detail: Check what else could be shaping the result.

notes.label: evaluate the whole distribution
notes.copy: Evaluate both the mean and standard deviation of satisfaction scores. Overall satisfaction should describe outcomes across the full student group, not one individual assignment.
notes.detail: The average is only one part of the result.

notes.label: test the intervention
notes.copy: A map can make nearby services visible by design. Whether residents can understand and use it is a separate question that requires observation and user testing.
notes.detail: Design intent is a hypothesis, not an outcome.

notes.label: make the workflow legible before changing it
notes.copy: F1 test cases and WinTrace state maps served the same purpose: establish how the existing system behaves before testing, explaining, or redesigning it.
notes.detail: Understand the current workflow before proposing the next one.
